description: Get list of users with pagination and filtering

search.description: Search in username, email, first name, or last name

sql: WITH UserRoles AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.ibmi_profile, u.status, u.created_date, u.last_modified_date, LISTAGG(r.role_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.role_name) AS roles FROM {{usersTable}} u LEFT JOIN {{userRolesTable}} ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN {{rolesTable}} r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE (u.status = {{statusFilter}} OR {{statusFilter}} = 'all') AND ({{searchTerm}} IS NULL OR UPPER(u.username) LIKE UPPER('%' || {{searchTerm}} || '%') OR UPPER(u.email) LIKE UPPER('%' || {{searchTerm}} || '%') OR UPPER(u.first_name) LIKE UPPER('%' || {{searchTerm}} || '%') OR UPPER(u.last_name) LIKE UPPER('%' || {{searchTerm}} || '%')) AND ({{roleFilter}} IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{userRolesTable}} ur2 JOIN {{rolesTable}} r2 ON ur2.role_id = r2.role_id WHERE ur2.user_id = u.user_id AND r2.role_name = {{roleFilter}})) GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.ibmi_profile, u.status, u.created_date, u.last_modified_date) SELECT user_id, username, email, first_name, last_name, ibmi_profile, status, roles, created_date, last_modified_date FROM UserRoles ORDER BY {{sortField}} {{sortDirection}} FETCH FIRST {{limit}} ROWS ONLY OFFSET {{offset}} ROWS
